channel.title: Houston Public Media - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Houston Public Media (houstonpublicmedia.org)

item.title: How HPD engages with ICE (March 12, 2026)
item.description: On Thursday's show: We learn about newly announced revisions to how HPD will engage with Immigration and Customs Enforcement. And we pay a visit to Lake Houston Wilderness Park.

item.title: Harris County Jail found to be in compliance with state standards for first time in over a year
item.description: The Texas Commission on Jail Standards issued a remedial order last year to address several issues of non-compliance in the Harris County Jail.

item.title: Artemis II leaders unanimously vote to move forward with mission in April
item.description: The flight-readiness review, a two-day discussion about preparations for the mission, concluded Thursday. NASA is moving forward with launching the moon-bound mission on April 1.

item.title: Critically endangered sea turtle rescued in Galveston, recovering at local rehab hospital
item.description: A bystander found the Kemp’s ridley sea turtle washed ashore while walking on a Galveston beach the morning of March 7. The lethargic turtle was clearly struggling as it was weighed down with barnacles, algae and sediment.

item.title: Fort Bend County Judge KP George maintains innocence as money laundering trial begins
item.description: George is accused of using campaign funds to make a down payment on a house and pay his property taxes. If convicted, he would be removed from office and face up to 10 years in prison and up to $10,000 in fines.

item.title: Woman sues Wyndham, other hotels over alleged connection to Houston sex trafficking
item.description: The lawsuit, filed Wednesday in federal court, seeks to recover profits the hotels earned as a result of alleged trafficking at their properties.

item.title: Houston rodeo leaders strip Lina Hidalgo of board role, deny she was ‘manhandled’ in concert dispute
item.description: Harris County’s top executive is the only elected official to request premium seats at the rodeo this year, according to event officials, who said Hidalgo was previously provided with 21 chute tickets with a total value of close to $9,000.

item.title: Harris County Judge alleges she was threatened, removed from Houston rodeo concert
item.description: Hidalgo, an Ex-Officio Director of the rodeo, said in a letter Wednesday evening that she attempted to bring another elected official, two children and the parents of a recently deceased U.S. Air Force sergeant to Megan Moroney's concert at NRG Stadium Tuesday.

item.title: Public schools bombarded by families scrambling for special education assessments tied to Texas voucher money
item.description: In order to qualify for up to $20,000 in additional funding for students with disabilities, Texas families seeking vouchers must obtain personalized evaluations from public school districts, which in many cases could be helping those families leave for private schools.

item.title: Emergency crews, pollution control respond to fire at Pasadena chemical plant
item.description: No injuries were immediately reported at the LyondellBasell plant southeast of Houston, according to the Harris County Fire Marshal's Office.
